item.title: Panthers outlast Jets 2-1 in shootout for fourth win in last six games
item.description: WINNIPEG — Anton Lundell and Sam Reinhart both beat Connor Hellebuyck in a shootout to lift the Florida Panthers to a 2-1 victory over the Winnipeg Jets on Thursday. Winnipeg shooters Kyle Connor and Mark Scheifele came up empty in extra time.

item.title: Penguins score three times within opening three minutes, cruise past Oilers 6-2
item.description: EDMONTON — Anthony Mantha scored twice as the Pittsburgh Penguins took a 3-0 lead before the game was even three minutes old and cruised to a 6-2 victory over the Edmonton Oilers on Thursday.

item.title: TikTok finalizes a deal to form a new American entity
item.description: TikTok has finalized a deal to create a new American entity, avoiding the looming threat of a ban in the United States that has been in discussion for years on the platform now used by more than 200 million Americans.

item.title: Japan's Takaichi dissolves parliament after only 3 months in office, setting up snap election
item.description: TOKYO (AP) — Japan’s Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi dissolved the lower house of Parliament on Friday, paving the way for a Feb. 8 snap election.

item.title: Nurse's two-goal effort leads Goldeneyes in 5-0 thumping of Sceptres
item.description: VANCOUVER — Sarah Nurse scored twice and Tereza Vanisova added a goal and an assist as the Vancouver Goldeneyes defeated the Toronto Sceptres 5-0 Thursday night for their first PWHL home win of 2026.
